_about: An upstream 2.25.1 app (80a7de8, before the Jev line) whose operator set cf_account_id and cf_api_token for the hourly Auto Setpoints check. Recorded, not written by hand: the options are that version's own config.yaml options: defaults with the operator's values over them, as the Supervisor writes /data/options.json (the credentials are stand-ins). No Jev file exists on such a box: its /data holds the state.json in entry_2_25_1_pumped_room.json.
